nodes.description: Private transfer routine that enforces bot checks, cooldown, max tx limit and triggers swap/ETH fee distribution before performing the reflection transfer.
Private function that approves the router and swaps contract tokens for ETH via the Uniswap V2 router, guarded by lockTheSwap.
Private function that forwards the accumulated ETH balance to the two fee wallets via address.transfer.
Owner-only function that creates the Uniswap pair, adds liquidity with the contract ETH balance and enables swapping/cooldown.
External function restricted to _feeAddrWallet1 that manually swaps the whole contract token balance for ETH.
External function restricted to _feeAddrWallet1 that manually sends the contract ETH balance to the fee wallets.
ERC20 transfer entry point that forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
ERC20 transferFrom entry point that performs the transfer and decrements the allowance.
Owner-only function that marks an array of addresses as bots, blocking their transfers.
Owner-only function that resets the max transaction amount back to the full total supply.
Mapping of address to last-trade timestamp used to enforce the 15 second cooldown between buys.
Maximum amount accepted in a transfer while the strict limit is enabled.
Total reflection supply used for the rAmount/tAmount conversion arithmetic.
Mapping holding the reflection balances that are actually mutated on transfer.
Contract owner address backing the onlyOwner modifier.
Uniswap V2 router instance used both for the swap and for adding liquidity.
Primary fee wallet that receives half of the swapped ETH and is the only allowed caller of the manual functions.
Untrusted caller address used for transfers, allowance spending and manual function authorization.
Miner-controlled timestamp used for the cooldown window and as the Uniswap swap/liquidity deadline.
External call to the Uniswap router swap that moves the contract token balance to ETH with amountOutMin 0.
External ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet1 and _feeAddrWallet2 executed after the swap.
External payable call to the router adding the contract ETH balance as liquidity with a timestamp deadline.
Mapping of addresses exempt from contract fees and from the cooldown/max-tx checks.
Parameter 'from' of _transfer.
Parameter 'to' of _transfer.
Parameter 'amount' of _transfer.
Local variable holding balanceOf(address(this)) and passed to swapTokensForEth.
Local variable holding address(this).balance and passed to sendETHToFee.
Parameter 'sender' of transferFrom.
Parameter 'recipient' of transferFrom.
Parameter 'amount' of transferFrom.
Parameter 'tokenAmount' of swapTokensForEth.
Parameter 'amount' of sendETHToFee.
Local address[] swap path built in swapTokensForEth.
Parameter 'recipient' of transfer.

edges.reason: Parameter 'from' of _transfer is used for the zero-address and bot checks.
Parameter 'to' of _transfer is the recipient and drives cooldown and fee lookup.
Parameter 'amount' of _transfer is compared against _maxTxAmount.
msg.sender becomes 'from' when transfer() calls _transfer.
cooldown[to] is written from block.timestamp, making the rate limit timestamp dependent.
The cooldown require in _transfer compares cooldown[to] with block.timestamp.
_isExcludedFromFee[to] is read inside _transfer to skip restrictions.
_maxTxAmount bounds the transfer amount in _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is passed as the tokenAmount argument to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is passed as the amount argument to sendETHToFee.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth, which performs an external router swap inside the transfer flow.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee, which pushes ETH out inside the transfer flow.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external Uniswap swap operation.
uniswapV2Router is the target contract used by swapTokensForEth.
block.timestamp is supplied as the swap deadline argument.
Parameter tokenAmount of swapTokensForEth is approved and swapped.
The local path array configures the token pair used by the swap.
sendETHToFee performs the external ETH transfers to the fee wallets.
Parameter amount of sendETHToFee is split and transferred out.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the ETH recipient inside sendETHToFee.
manualswap requires that msg.sender equals _feeAddrWallet1.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the hard-coded privileged caller compared in manualswap.
manualsend requires that msg.sender equals _feeAddrWallet1.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the hard-coded privileged caller compared in manualsend.
manualswap unconditionally calls swapTokensForEth on the full contract balance.
manualsend unconditionally calls sendETHToFee on the full ETH balance.
openTrading is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
The onlyOwner check compares _owner with _msgSender() in openTrading.
openTrading calls the router addLiquidityETH with the contract ETH balance.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the addLiquidityETH call.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline in openTrading.
setBots is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
removeStrictTxLimit is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
transfer delegates the whole transfer logic to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the whole transfer logic to _transfer.
Parameter recipient of transfer is forwarded to _transfer.
Parameter amount of transfer is forwarded to _transfer.
Parameter sender of transferFrom is forwarded to _transfer and allowance lookup.
Parameter recipient of transferFrom is forwarded to _transfer.
Parameter amount of transferFrom is subtracted from the allowance.
msg.sender is used as the spender/sender inside transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender approving the allowance in transferFrom.
removeStrictTxLimit overwrites the _maxTxAmount state variable.
_rTotal participates in the reflection rate arithmetic used during _transfer.
_rOwned balances of sender and recipient are updated in _transfer.
